description: Returns a hosted Stripe Checkout URL at the live flat price. For an eligible ordinary document, the protected draft must already be ready and the person must have accepted the private review; payment then unlocks the clean PDF, download and delivery options. Purpose-built report/workspace flows may require payment before drafting. If an eligibility notice is returned, the person must hear it before acknowledge_notice is true.

acknowledge_notice.description: Set true after the person has heard the eligibility notice returned by answer_questions or a previous call.

case_id.description: The case id returned by start_document.

registered_post.description: Add registered post delivery of a letter (extra fee, shown in list_services).
